subject.title: [Feature]: View Codex sessions across Gateway and paired nodes

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a federated Codex session catalog now, and should it live as a codex-supervisor-owned metadata surface across Gateway, node commands, CLI, Control UI, and native macOS nodes?
rationale: The feature is aligned but crosses product UX and security boundaries; automation should not decide whether the existing per-host `/codex sessions --host` command is enough or whether the broader catalog should become a maintained OpenClaw surface.

options.title: Sponsor plugin-owned catalog
options.body: Proceed with the metadata-only codex-supervisor design, with explicit node approval, redaction, CLI/Control UI parity, and security review before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to existing per-host command
options.body: Keep the current `/codex sessions --host <node>` flow as the supported operator path and close or defer the broader Control UI catalog direction.

options.title: Defer until node transport settles
options.body: Wait for the related remote Codex app-server and command-backed transport issues to settle before adding a federated catalog surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor plugin-owned catalog
recommendation.body: Proceed with the metadata-only codex-supervisor design, with explicit node approval, redaction, CLI/Control UI parity, and security review before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the maintainer-labeled product request and recently merged adjacent Codex session-node work.
